content: external-dns v0.21.0 (Apr 2026): native Cloudflare provider with per-ingress annotations (cloudflare-proxied etc). For Mikrotik LAN DNS use webhook provider mirceanton/external-dns-provider-mikrotik v1.6.3 (manages RouterOS static DNS via API, runs as sidecar). Alternative: benfiola/external-dns-routeros-provider. Run two external-dns instances (one per provider) filtered by annotation/label.
